body.data:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<cal:calendar-query
    xmlns:d="DAV:"
    xmlns:cal="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav">
  <d:prop>
    <d:getetag />
    <cal:calendar-data>
      <cal:comp name="VCALENDAR">
        <cal:prop name="VERSION" />
        <cal:comp name="VTODO">
          <cal:prop name="UID" />
          <cal:prop name="SUMMARY" />
          <cal:prop name="DESCRIPTION" />
          <cal:prop name="CREATED" />
          <cal:prop name="DTSTART" />
          <cal:prop name="DUE" />
          <cal:prop name="PRIORITY" />
          <cal:prop name="STATUS" />
          <cal:prop name="PERCENT-COMPLETE" />
          <cal:prop name="RELATED-TO" />
        </cal:comp>
      </cal:comp>
    </cal:calendar-data>
  </d:prop>
  <cal:filter>
    <cal:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR">
      <cal:comp-filter name="VTODO">
        <cal:prop-filter name="COMPLETED">
          <cal:is-not-defined />
        </cal:prop-filter>
      </cal:comp-filter>
    </cal:comp-filter>
  </cal:filter>
</cal:calendar-query>

password.description: Stored in the flow and visible in exports. Prefer HTTP (OAuth2).
